title: Objects that tell who we are
objective: Présenter un objet qui compte pour soi et expliquer en quoi il nous représente

steps.title: Warm-up: three objects, one person
steps.student_instruction: Look at three objects on the board. Guess who owns them: age, hobbies, personality. Justify: It must be someone who...
steps.facilitator_instruction: Projeter trois objets (casque, carnet de croquis, ballon). Faire produire des hypothèses avec must / might et les noter.

steps.title: Listening: favourite things
steps.student_instruction: Listen to five young people. Note each object, how long they have had it and why it matters.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Audio British Council « Favourite things » (QR code du cahier) ; sans réseau, lire deux fois le script de secours. Première écoute : les cinq objets ; seconde : les raisons (liberté, compagnie, projet professionnel).

steps.title: Language focus: present perfect with for / since and relative clauses
steps.student_instruction: Complete: I've had my guitar ___ 2022 / ___ three years. Join the sentences with which or that.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Present perfect pour une situation qui dure encore ; for + durée, since + point de départ. Relatives which / that / who pour enrichir la description.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet, then compare with a partner.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : compléter une présentation guidée ; B : rédiger une présentation à partir de notes ; C : texte argumenté « un objet peut-il dire qui nous sommes ? ».

steps.title: Speaking: one-minute show and tell
steps.student_instruction: Present your object in one minute: what it is, how long you've had it, what it says about you. Your group asks two questions.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Chronométrer ; exiger au moins un present perfect et une relative. Les auditeurs notent une information et posent une question de relance.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write two sentences about your object: one with for or since, one with which or that.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Ramasser ; repérer I have this since (calque du français).

sheets.student_content: Complete the presentation with: since, for, which, have had. My favourite thing is my bike, ___ my grandfather gave me. I ___ it ___ four years, ___ I was twelve. It means freedom to me.
Use your notes (object / since when / three reasons) to write an eight-line presentation of an object that matters to you.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production guidée ; attendus : present perfect + for / since, une relative, trois raisons reliées (because, also, above all).

sheets.student_content: Write a short opinion text (150 words): "Our things say who we are." Do you agree? Use examples from the recording and from your life.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; attendus : position claire, deux exemples dont un tiré de l'écoute, connecteurs (however, for instance), conclusion.

criteria: L'élève présente un objet et sa signification personnelle
L'élève emploie le present perfect avec for ou since
L'élève relève au moins trois raisons dans l'écoute

common_errors: I have this phone since two years (calque)
Relative omise : the bike my grandfather gave me it
theme: Axe 1 - Représentation de soi et rapport à autrui
